item.title: Rallying Cry – June 4, 2026
item.description: Today’s bright spots include a promising new ovarian cancer drug, Finland’s president advocating for EU expansion to include Canada, NBA Finals magic as Karl-Anthony Towns honored his late mother, and a beloved Australian department store making a triumphant return after decades.
